item: All accounts use passwords of 12+ characters
Two-factor authentication is on for email and admin accounts
Everyone stores passwords in the company password manager
Every laptop has full-disk encryption turned on
Laptops lock after five minutes idle
Customer data is backed up weekly
A backup restore was tested this quarter
Access is removed within 24 hours when someone leaves
Only two people have admin rights on the web shop
Nobody shares a login, including on the warehouse PC
Admin logs were checked this week for unusual logins
Everyone finished security training in the last six months
